title: Boston Gas Company submits for review and approval a 365-Day Firm Transportation Agreement with South Shore Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman: Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. and Deirdre K. Manning. (DTE 04-GC-28)
